answer: One concrete defense is a proof-of-work gate paired with a bond: every agent must solve a small hash puzzle and lock a deposit before it can act, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand puzzles and a thousand bonds. Add a graph check too, since genuine agents cluster like a river feeding the sea while sybils all hang off one vertex with no organic edges. A terrace of vouching helps: new identities earn weight only through endorsements by aged peers, and a voucher who backs a cluster of fakes forfeits its own stake. The attacker pays compute, capital, and reputation at once.
